name: Daehak Jogyo Saenghwal
source:
As graduation from university approached, I didn't really have anything I wanted to do.
While I was worrying about my career, a professor who thought well of me said,

"Have you considered becoming a teaching assistant?"

A teaching assistant...?
I thought the professor's suggestion was a good opportunity to stay at the university a bit longer and prepare myself for change.
And so, I said...

"I'll be a teaching assistant."

I chose to stay on at the university.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3867010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大学毕业的日子越来越近了，我却没有什么想做的事。
当我正在为自己的职业生涯而烦恼时，一位对我很好的教授说：

“你考虑过当助教吗？”

助教……？
我认为教授的建议是一个很好的机会，可以在大学多呆一段时间，为自己的改变做好准备。
所以，我说……

“我要当助教。”

我选择留在大学。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3867010/]Steam[/url]]
